content: i built a working MVP in 3 hours yesterday. zero lines of code written by hand. cursor did 95% of the work, i just directed traffic. this is the future — either you're prompt-engineering your way to products or you're manually typing syntax like it's 2015.

the vibe coding workflow that actually works:

1. describe the app in 3 sentences
2. let AI scaffold everything
3. fix the 10% that breaks
4. ship

most people get stuck on step 1. they overthink. just describe what you want. the AI will figure out the rest.

build in public isn't about posting every win. it's about being honest about the struggle. last week i spent 6 hours on a bug that turned out to be a missing comma. posted it. 47 people replied with similar stories. that's the value. connection through honesty.

unpopular opinion: the best AI tool isn't cursor. it isn't claude. it's the one you actually USE consistently. i know people paying for every premium AI app and still shipping nothing. usage > tool collection. pick one, master it, start shipping.

question: what's your current project and what's ONE thing holding you back?

i'll go first: working on a content automation tool, stuck on figuring out the pricing page. classic analysis paralysis.

drop yours. let's problem-solve together.
